device.basis: Imaging block of X-T20 2.11 section 5 configured by 0xc3c100..0xc3f8c4 (words +0x04..+0x204), with enable bits in +0x04 updated by read-modify-write. The stop 0xc3c0c0 writes 0 to +0x00 and waits until bit 0 reads set, so bit 0 is declared idle. The words read back their last write; what the block computes is not modeled.
